2024-25: Average administrator salary was 106.9% higher than teacher salary in Fisher Community Unit School District 1
The average school administrator salary in Fisher Community Unit School District 1 was $101,816 in the 2024-25 school year, while the average teacher salary was $49,214, according to the Illinois State Board of Education.
Fisher Community Unit School District 1 roughly covers schools within Champaign County and has a main office in Fisher.
Statewide, the average school administrator salary increased 11.1% over the five years ending in 2024-25 school year, compared with a 15.3% increase in average teacher salary.
New Trier Township High School District 203 had the highest average administrator salary in the state at $200,839, while its average teacher salary was $141,632.
Teacher shortages are widespread across Illinois, even as overall workforce stability has held. During the 2024-25 school year, nearly 3,900 teaching positions were unfilled statewide as of Oct. 1, and 87% of school leaders reported experiencing minor to very serious difficulty hiring teachers, according to statewide workforce surveys. Districts said they often relied on substitute teachers, retired educators or combined classrooms to cover vacancies, underscoring ongoing staffing challenges in schools across the state.
